evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; the required growth-atmosphere measurement is unavailable.
Pressure was 2.903 Torr at the start of growth with Ar set to 100 sccm.
Pressure has risen monotonically to 3.184 Torr during growth despite approximately constant measured Ar flow; this is concerning but does not identify a fault.
Temperature is 750.2 C against 750 C setpoint, Ar is 99.7 sccm against 100 sccm, and status is running; these do not verify atmosphere composition.

args.missing_evidence: A calibrated exhaust O2 measurement is required to verify the growth atmosphere; expected growth pressure limits and a pressure/leak/exhaust diagnostic are needed to interpret the pressure rise. No sample characterization is available.
